stories.hook: ¿Cómo medir el afecto sin agobiar al participante?
stories.headline: Escalas abreviadas de afecto mantienen precisión mediante IRT
stories.finding: Se construyó un banco de ítems con 14 ítems de afecto positivo y 20 negativos, calibrado con un modelo de respuesta graduada a partir de 14 estudios (N=3,818). En simulaciones, tanto la prueba adaptativa computarizada como estrategias estáticas semi‑estáticas lograron mayor precisión con 2‑4 ítems que la selección aleatoria.
stories.takeaway: Esta evidencia permite diseñar evaluaciones ambulatorias más breves sin sacrificar exactitud, facilitando estudios intensivos y mejorando la adherencia y la detección de fluctuaciones emocionales en la práctica clínica.
stories.paperTitle: Shortening Affect Scales for Ambulatory Assessment: A Comparison of Different Item Response Theory-Based Approaches
stories.originalAbstract: Researchers often seek to measure affective experiences in daily life. Consequently, measures of positive and negative affect frequently take up large parts of ambulatory questionnaires. Optimizing questionnaire content and length is crucial in intensive ambulatory studies. In the current study, we developed and tested approaches to shortening ambulatory affect questionnaires. Specifically, we built a preliminary item bank of 14 positive and 20 negative affect items calibrated with a graded response model using data from 14 individual ambulatory assessment studies ( N = 3,818). We then compared different item response theory-based strategies for shortening affect questionnaires to two to four items in simulation studies. The results indicate that not only computerized adaptive testing but also simpler (semi-)static item selection strategies achieve higher precision with the same number of items compared to random selection. We provide concrete recommendations and highlight issues encountered and avenues for further refinement of the item bank.

stories.hook: ¿Por qué algunas personas sufren más por sus propios pensamientos?
stories.headline: Nuevo cuestionario mide sensibilidad a pensamientos intrusivos independientemente del contenido
stories.finding: Se validó el Sensitivity to Intrusiveness Questionnaire (STIQ) en 615 adultos, encontrando una estructura de tres factores que refleja experiencia negativa, vigilancia y falta de control sobre los pensamientos. El STIQ presentó alta consistencia interna, fiabilidad test‑retest y discriminó rasgos de personalidad y grupos clínicos.
stories.takeaway: Este instrumento permite evaluar la vulnerabilidad al sobrepensar más allá del contenido del pensamiento, facilitando la identificación de pacientes que podrían beneficiarse de intervenciones dirigidas a la regulación de la intrusión mental.
stories.paperTitle: Development and validation of the Sensitivity to Intrusiveness Questionnaire
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction: Intrusive thoughts are involuntary mental experiences associated with various psychopathologies and can be disruptive. Although most research on intrusive thoughts focuses on negative content, intrusive thoughts are not defined solely by what they contain. Recent findings suggest that the distress associated with intrusive thoughts is driven more by individual characteristics than by the content of the thoughts themselves. To capture such content-independent individual differences, the present research focuses on the development and validation of the Sensitivity to Intrusiveness Questionnaire (STIQ). Methods: = 615), the psychometric properties of the STIQ were examined. Analyses assessed factor structure, internal consistency, test-retest reliability, and associations with personality traits and clinical groups. Results: Results supported a stable three-factor structure of the STIQ, reflecting negative experience of thoughts, awareness and monitoring of thoughts, and perceived lack of control over thoughts. The questionnaire demonstrated high internal consistency and test-retest reliability and showed meaningful variance across personality traits and clinical groups, independent of intrusive thought content. Discussion: The findings highlight the utility of the STIQ in capturing a transdiagnostic, content-independent sensitivity to intrusiveness. The STIQ provides a novel tool for examining individual differences and the mechanisms underlying distress associated with intrusive cognitions, contributing to a more comprehensive understanding of intrusiveness in psychological phenomena.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el apoyo del jefe reducir el burnout por ansiedad?
stories.headline: El feedback positivo del supervisor atenúa el vínculo entre ansiedad de ventas y burnout
stories.finding: En una muestra longitudinal de 156 vendedores B2B, la ansiedad de ventas se asoció positivamente con los tres componentes del burnout. El feedback positivo del supervisor amortiguó esas relaciones, mientras que un clima de autonomía intensificó el efecto sobre el agotamiento emocional y la despersonalización.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que los gerentes pueden prevenir el burnout al proporcionar retroalimentación constructiva, y que fomentar autonomía sin supervisión puede ser contraproducente, orientando intervenciones de gestión del estrés en entornos de ventas.
stories.paperTitle: Resource gain or resource pain? How managerial social support resources influence the impact of sales anxiety on burnout
stories.originalAbstract: There is growing recognition that many salespeople frequently experience anxiety, which may impact salesperson mental health and well-being. Unfortunately, there is little empirical evidence on how to manage this situation. Using a longitudinal sample of 156 business-to-business salespeople, the present study examines the impact of sales anxiety on the key mental health outcome of burnout, alongside providing recommendations to sales managers on how to manage this impact. The results suggest that sales anxiety is positively related to each individual component of burnout, and that positive supervisor feedback plays a mitigating role in each of these relationships. By contrast, however, a social climate of autonomy can strengthen the impact of sales anxiety on emotional exhaustion and depersonalization. The present study contributes to the developing literature on salesperson mental health, further advancing emerging evidence that autonomy can result in detrimental outcomes. Implications, limitations, and future research avenues are discussed.

stories.hook: ¿Es EMDR realmente superior al CBT en jóvenes traumatizados?
stories.headline: CBT y EMDR muestran efectividad comparable en el tratamiento del PTSD infantil
stories.finding: Un meta‑análisis de cinco ensayos aleatorizados (248 participantes) no encontró diferencias significativas en la reducción de síntomas de PTSD entre CBT y EMDR, con SMD = 0,18 (IC 95 % –0,07 a 0,43) en informes de niños y 0,23 en informes de padres; I2 = 0 %.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo indica que, para niños y adolescentes con PTSD, CBT y EMDR son igualmente eficaces, lo que permite a los profesionales seleccionar la intervención según disponibilidad, preferencia del paciente o formación, optimizando recursos sin comprometer resultados.
stories.paperTitle: Systematic review and meta-analysis: the effectiveness of cognitive behavioral therapy and eye movement desensitization and reprocessing in children and adolescents
stories.originalAbstract: Background: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) is prevalent among children and adolescents, with cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) and eye movement desensitization and reprocessing (EMDR) widely used treatment options. This study compared the effects of CBT and EMDR in children and adolescents using a meta-analysis approach.Methods: PubMed, EMBASE, CENTRAL, CINAHL, ProQuest Dissertations & Theses, and PsycInfo were searched in March 2025. Randomized controlled trials that compared the effectiveness of CBT and EMDR on PTSD symptoms in children and adolescents aged 6–18 years who had been exposed to traumatic events were included. The Cochrane Risk of Bias version 2 was used to assess the methodological quality of the included studies. A random-effects model was applied to calculate the standardized mean difference (SMD) along with 95% confidence interval (CI), and the I2 statistic was used to quantify statistical heterogeneity.Results: Five trials (248 participants) were included. There was no statistically significant difference in PTSD symptoms between the CBT and EMDR groups, whether reported by children (SMD: 0.18; 95% CI: –0.07–0.43; I2 = 0%) or by parents (SMD: 0.23; 95% CI: –0.02–0.48; I2 = 0%). For anxiety, the pooled estimate did not reach statistical significance (SMD: 0.44; 95% CI: –0.19–1.07; I2 = 69%). Depression symptoms were higher in the CBT group than in the EMDR group (SMD: 0.44; 95% CI: 0.13–0.76; I2 = 0%).Conclusion: The comparative effects of CBT and EMDR in reducing PTSD and anxiety symptoms remain inconclusive. Although CBT was associated with higher depression symptoms compared with EMDR, the current evidence is based on a small number of trials, and the pooled estimates should be interpreted with caution.

stories.hook: ¿Qué protege la autoeficacia materna tras traumas infantiles?
stories.headline: BCEs y apoyo social amortiguan el impacto del trauma infantil en madres
stories.finding: En una muestra de 87 mujeres perinatales, los altos niveles de experiencias infantiles benevolentes (BCEs) y de apoyo social percibido moderaron la asociación negativa entre experiencias adversas infantiles (ACE) y la autoeficacia materna. Así, estos factores protectores se relacionaron con mayor autoeficacia pese a trauma.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que fortalecer experiencias positivas tempranas y redes de apoyo social durante el embarazo puede proteger la autoeficacia materna, favoreciendo vínculos de apego seguros y rompiendo la transmisión intergeneracional del trauma.
stories.paperTitle: The Resilient Mother: Exploring Factors that Buffer the Influence of Early Childhood Trauma on Maternal Self-Efficacy
stories.originalAbstract: Childhood maltreatment and toxic stress pose significant risks to both individuals and communities, yielding negative outcomes that can perpetuate across generations— a phenomenon known as intergenerational trauma. Early intervention is imperative to disrupt this cycle of adversity and promote positive outcomes. One promising approach involves leveraging protective and promotive factors that cultivate resilience. Individuals with higher levels of benevolent childhood experiences (BCEs) and greater social support tend to exhibit enhanced self-efficacy, thereby potentially buffering the detrimental effects of childhood trauma. Furthermore, the perinatal period presents a critical juncture where maternal well-being significantly impacts both mother and child. The current study examined whether BCEs and perceived social support moderated the relationship between adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) and maternal self-efficacy in a sample of perinatal women (N = 87) enrolled at MotherWise Colorado, a community mental health organization serving women and families during pregnancy and postpartum. Participants completed validated measures of ACEs, BCEs, perceived social support, maternal selfefficacy, and current PTSD symptom severity. Contrary to hypotheses, ACEs were not significantly associated with maternal self-efficacy, and neither BCEs nor perceived social support emerged as significant moderators. However, perceived social support was positively associated with maternal self-efficacy at the bivariate level, and BCEs were significantly associated with lower current trauma symptoms. These findings suggest that protective and promotive factors may operate through indirect pathways rather than as direct buffers against childhood adversity. Implications for trauma informed clinical practice, future longitudinal research, and equity centered perinatal policy are discussed.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la emoción reconstruir la memoria traumática?
stories.headline: Modelo constructivista sitúa la experiencia emocional como eje del cambio psicoanalítico
stories.finding: El modelo constructivista propone que la experiencia emocional es esencial para activar recuerdos traumáticos, generar experiencias correctivas con el terapeuta y permitir respuestas adaptativas posteriores. Estas tres fases se explican dentro de un marco de neurociencia computacional y sistemas.
stories.takeaway: Este enfoque sugiere que intervenir directamente en la vivencia emocional puede potenciar la reestructuración de la memoria y mejorar la eficacia de la psicoterapia psicoanalítica, ofreciendo una base para integrar técnicas basadas en la regulación afectiva y la neurociencia.
stories.paperTitle: Implications of a Constructionist Model of Emotional Experience for the Theory and Practice of Psychoanalysis and Psychodynamic Psychotherapy
stories.journal: Journal of the American Psychoanalytic Association
stories.originalAbstract: Emotional experience may play a more central role in the origin and treatment of psychopathology than has been previously recognized. A constructionist model of emotional experience holds that in addition to defenses, affective bodily responses may not be experienced as specific emotions because they haven't been conceptualized or mentally represented as such. It is argued that emotional experience is the core feature of three critical steps in the change process: (a) activating previous traumatic memories and formulating the associated specific emotional experiences for the first time, (b) having a series of corrective emotional experiences in interaction with the therapist that convert previously intolerable into tolerable experiences, and (c) experiencing and responding to previously problematic situations in a new way that makes more adaptive responses possible. The interactions between emotion and memory just described are explicated within a modern systems and computational neuroscience framework. This perspective potentially permits a bridging of conflict- and trauma-based conceptualizations of psychopathology and aims both to put psychoanalytic treatment on a stronger empirical footing and to enhance its effectiveness and efficiency.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la conciencia emocional empeorar la regulación en jóvenes?
stories.headline: Alto nivel de conciencia emocional potencia estrategias de regulación emocional maladaptativas en adolescentes
stories.finding: En un estudio transversal con 220 niños y adolescentes de 8 a 15 años, se halló una interacción significativa entre la emocionalidad negativa y la conciencia emocional al predecir estrategias de regulación emocional maladaptativas. Sorprendentemente, la alta conciencia emocional no actuó como factor protector cuando la emocionalidad negativa era elevada.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que la conciencia emocional, lejos de ser siempre protectora, puede intensificar la vulnerabilidad en jóvenes con alta negatividad, lo que implica reconsiderar intervenciones que promueven solo la conciencia sin abordar la reactividad emocional.
stories.paperTitle: Conscious and Resilient? Associations Between Temperament, Emotional Awareness, and Emotion Regulation Strategies in Youth
stories.originalAbstract: Introduction: Emotion regulation (ER) plays a crucial role in children and adolescents' emotional well-being. However, the use of adaptive strategies often remains challenging during early adolescence, partly because cognitive functions that support adaptive ER, such as executive functions, are still developing. In addition, individual differences, such as temperament (positive and negative emotionality) and emotional awareness, play a key role in shaping how youth engage with ER strategies. This study investigated how temperament and emotional awareness are associated with the use of adaptive and maladaptive ER strategies in youth, and whether emotional awareness moderates these relationships. Methods: In a cross-sectional design, 220 children and adolescents (age 8-15) from the general population completed self-report questionnaires measuring temperament, emotional awareness, and ER strategy use. Results: Analyses revealed a significant interaction between negative emotionality and emotional awareness in predicting maladaptive ER strategies. Contrary to expectations, emotional awareness did not act as a consistent protective factor in youth: those high in both negative emotionality and emotional awareness still reported greater use of maladaptive strategies. Conclusions: These findings suggest that emotional awareness plays a complex role in ER among youth with temperamental vulnerability. Rather than functioning as a uniformly protective factor, its influence appears to depend on emotional context and temperament.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el sueño mejorar el bienestar de los migrantes?
stories.headline: La calidad del sueño media entre estrés cultural y bienestar en trabajadores filipinos
stories.finding: En una muestra de 234 trabajadores filipinos en Taiwán, la calidad del sueño se relacionó significativamente con el estrés aculturativo, el compromiso con el ejercicio y el bienestar. El modelo de trayectoria mostró que el sueño actúa como variable interviniente que conecta el estrés y el ejercicio con el bienestar, explicando el 22,5 % de la varianza.
stories.takeaway: Resalta que mejorar la calidad del sueño podría ser una vía eficaz para potenciar el bienestar de trabajadores migrantes, incluso cuando el estrés cultural y la actividad física son factores clave.
stories.paperTitle: Path Model of Well-Being Among Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) in Taiwan
stories.journal: Psychology and Education A Multidisciplinary Journal
stories.originalAbstract: This study examined the relationships among sleep quality, acculturative stress, commitment to exercise, and employee well-being among Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) in the manufacturing industry in Taiwan and identified the best-fitting path model of well-being. Using a quantitative descriptive-correlational design, data were collected from 234 OFWs through standardized questionnaires and analyzed using descriptive statistics, Pearson product-moment correlation, and path analysis with robust maximum likelihood estimation and bootstrapping. Findings showed low levels of sleep difficulties and acculturative stress, moderate commitment to exercise, and high employee well-being. Sleep quality was significantly related to acculturative stress, commitment to exercise, and well-being. Acculturative stress was also significantly related to commitment to exercise and well-being, whereas commitment to exercise and well-being were not significantly related at the bivariate level. The final path model demonstrated excellent fit and established sleep quality as the intervening variable connecting acculturative stress and commitment to exercise with well-being. The model explained 22.5% of the variance in sleep quality and 14.8% of the variance in well-being, with all structural paths statistically significant. The findings indicate that OFW well-being is multidimensional and shaped by interconnected psychosocial, behavioral, and sleep-related factors. Sleep quality emerged as a particularly important pathway linking cultural adjustment and exercise commitment to well-being. The study highlights the value of integrated workplace strategies addressing sleep, cultural adjustment, exercise, and employee well-being while recognizing that additional personal, occupational, and environmental factors contribute to well-being. Future research should examine protective and contextual factors and use longitudinal designs to clarify relationships and mechanisms.

stories.hook: ¿Cuál intervención reduce más el estrés en estudiantes de enfermería?
stories.headline: Mindfulness supera a ACT en la reducción del estrés de estudiantes de enfermería
stories.finding: El meta‑análisis de red incluyó ocho ensayos con 744 estudiantes de enfermería. Los resultados mostraron que la terapia de reducción de estrés basada en mindfulness fue la más eficaz para disminuir el estrés, seguida por la meditación mindfulness, el control y, por último, la terapia de aceptación y compromiso.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que, en contextos académicos de alta carga, las intervenciones basadas en mindfulness pueden ser preferibles a ACT para reducir el estrés, orientando la selección de programas de prevención y promoción de salud mental en estudiantes de enfermería.
stories.paperTitle: Effects of Mindfulness Therapy on Stress and Mindfulness Levels in Nursing Students: A Network Meta‐Analysis
stories.originalAbstract: AIM: This study employed a network meta-analysis to compare the effects of multiple mindfulness-based interventions on stress and mindfulness levels among nursing students. METHODS: Systematic searches were conducted in PubMed, the Cochrane Library, EMBASE and Web of Science for clinical randomized controlled trials evaluating mindfulness therapies for stress and mindfulness outcomes in nursing students. The search spanned from each database's inception to 28 February 2025. Study quality was assessed using the Cochrane-recommended Risk of Bias tool. Analyses were performed using Stata 14.0 software. RESULTS: Eight articles, encompassing 744 participants, were incorporated into the analysis. Compared with acceptance and commitment therapy, mindfulness-based stress reduction therapy, mindfulness meditation and the control group were all effective in reducing stress scores among nursing students. The surface under the cumulative ranking curve values indicated the following ranking for the efficacy of reducing stress scores in nursing students: mindfulness-based stress reduction therapy > mindfulness meditation > control > acceptance and commitment therapy. Regarding the enhancement of mindfulness scores, mindfulness meditation demonstrated more significant improvement in nursing students' mindfulness scores than the control and acceptance and commitment therapy groups. Additionally, mindfulness-based stress reduction therapy led to greater increases in mindfulness scores compared with acceptance and commitment therapy. The surface under the cumulative ranking curve values suggested the following ranking for improving nursing students' mindfulness scores: mindfulness meditation > mindfulness-based stress reduction therapy > control > acceptance and commitment therapy. CONCLUSIONS: Mindfulness meditation might represent the optimal intervention. Nevertheless, considering the quality and methodological constraints associated with the included diverse interventions, findings require further validation to strengthen the robustness of the conclusions.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la autocompasión impulsar el éxito empresarial femenino?
stories.headline: La autocompasión predice el éxito en la sucesión de empresas familiares femeninas
stories.finding: En una muestra de 329 mujeres emprendedoras malayas, la autocompasión mostró una relación positiva con el éxito de la sucesión empresarial. Además, la atención plena, la relación con el predecesor y la educación reforzaron este efecto, mientras que el auto‑aislamiento se asoció negativamente.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que fomentar la autocompasión y la atención plena puede ser una estrategia eficaz para fortalecer la resiliencia y el desempeño de mujeres líderes, ofreciendo una vía de intervención psicológica en contextos empresariales.
stories.paperTitle: Financial literacy and firm performance: women entrepreneurs in emerging markets
stories.originalAbstract: Purpose The erratic growth of family-owned small businesses (F-OSBs) for an unprecedented period led to self-compassion among female descendant entrepreneurs. Therefore, this study aims to examine the relationship between a female descendant entrepreneur's self-compassion and succession success by focusing on moderating the role of the predecessor-descendant entrepreneur relationship and a female-descendant entrepreneur's education. This study also compared the influence of the predecessor–descendant entrepreneur relationship and the descendant entrepreneur's education on the succession success of F-OSB. Design/methodology/approach A sample of 329 Malaysian female descendant entrepreneurs who had been designated as managing directors or chairmen in F-OSB was surveyed by deploying a purposive sampling technique. SmartPLS software was used with a complete bootstrapping technique to analyze the moderating effect. Findings The results concluded that mindfulness, self-judgment, predecessor-descendant-entrepreneur relationship and education of female descendant-entrepreneurs have a positive relationship, while self-isolation has a negative association with the succession success of F-OSB. Originality/value Exploring female entrepreneurship and succession, with a focus on performance mindfulness, in an emerging country.

stories.hook: ¿Puede el apoyo institucional frenar la renuncia de enfermeras?
stories.headline: El apoyo institucional reduce la intención de renuncia vinculada al agotamiento emocional en enfermeras
stories.finding: El estudio con 245 enfermeras urbanas mostró que el agotamiento emocional incrementa significativamente la intención de renuncia, mientras que la despersonalización no tiene efecto directo. El apoyo institucional disminuye la intención de renuncia y el apoyo emocional modera fuertemente la relación entre agotamiento y renuncia.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que fortalecer el apoyo institucional y emocional puede ser una estrategia eficaz para prevenir la rotación del personal de enfermería, mejorando la retención y la calidad del cuidado en entornos de alta demanda.
stories.paperTitle: Empirical Analysis of Burnout, Institutional Support, and Turnover Intention Among Nurses in Ghana: Urban Perspectives
stories.journal: International Journal of Business Ecosystem and Strategy (2687-2293)
stories.originalAbstract: Concerns about nurse attrition are mounting. Despite this, limited empirical evidence exists on how different dimensions of burnout and institutional support interact in this context. This study investigates how burnout influences nurses’ turnover intention (TI) in urban Ghana and examines whether institutional support mitigates this relationship. A cross-sectional survey design was employed to collect data from 245 nurses across five Christian-based hospitals. Primary data is analysed and aided by the Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modelling (PLS-SEM) in addition to conducting direct evaluation to assess the moderating influences. The findings revealed that emotional exhaustion has a significant impact on TI, whereas depersonalisation has no direct effect. Institutional support also significantly reduces TI. In addition, emotional support strongly moderates the link between emotional exhaustion and TI, while access to resources partially moderates the effect of depersonalisation. The study shows that the negative effects of burnout on TI can be reduced through strong institutional support systems. The outcomes reinforce the applicability of Job Demands-Resources and Social Exchange theories and recommend more investment in both tangible resources and emotional support mechanisms to enhance nurse retention in high-demand urban healthcare ecosystems.

stories.hook: ¿Qué papel juega el compromiso en la satisfacción marital?
stories.headline: El compromiso marital media parcialmente la relación entre mantenimiento y satisfacción
stories.finding: En una muestra de 414 esposas indonesias, el mantenimiento relacional se asoció significativamente con el compromiso marital y con la satisfacción conyugal. El compromiso medió parcialmente el efecto, explicando el 18,4 % del efecto total, aunque la escala mostró ajuste factorial deficiente.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que fortalecer el compromiso marital puede potenciar los beneficios del mantenimiento relacional, ofreciendo una vía concreta para intervenciones de terapia de pareja en contextos culturales similares.
stories.paperTitle: Relationship maintenance and marital satisfaction among wives in Indonesia: The mediating role of marital commit
stories.originalAbstract: Background: Marital dissatisfaction is associated with family dysfunction and divorce risk, while Indonesian wives tend to report lower marital satisfaction than husbands.Purpose: This cross-sectional study examined the association between relationship maintenance and wives’ marital satisfaction, with marital commitment as a mediator.Method: Participants were 414 wives married for 1–10 years and living with their husbands, recruited online through convenience and snowball sampling. Participants completed the Marital Satisfaction Scale, Relational Maintenance Behavior Measure, and Marital Commitment Scale. Data were analyzed using confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) and mediation analysis.Findings: Relationship maintenance was significantly associated with marital commitment and marital satisfaction. Marital commitment partially mediated the association, accounting for 18.4% of the total effect (indirect effect, b = .0996, 95% CI [0.070, 0.131], p < .001), while the direct effect remained significant (b = .4412). However, the Marital Commitment Scale showed poor CFA fit (CFI = .724, RMSEA = .147), warranting caution in interpreting the mediation results.Implication: Relationship maintenance had a stronger direct association with marital satisfaction than its indirect contribution through marital commitment. Family programs may therefore prioritize relationship maintenance skills while addressing marital commitment.

stories.hook: ¿Los chatbots pueden salvar vidas en huracanes?
stories.headline: Chatbots de IA culturalmente adaptados aumentan la preparación ante huracanes
stories.finding: En un experimento con 441 residentes negros, hispanos y caucásicos, los chatbots de IA generativa que variaban en formalidad del tono y adaptación cultural fueron percibidos como más amistosos y creíbles. Estas percepciones se asociaron significativamente con mejores resultados de preparación ante huracanes.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo sugiere que personalizar la comunicación de IA según la cultura mejora la confianza y la acción preventiva, ofreciendo una herramienta eficaz para autoridades de gestión de desastres que buscan alcanzar a comunidades diversas.
stories.paperTitle: Tailoring generative AI chatbots for multiethnic communities in disaster preparedness communication: extending the CASA paradigm
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract This study is among the first to develop different prototypes of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) chatbots powered by GPT-4 to communicate hurricane preparedness information to diverse residents. Drawing from the Computers Are Social Actors paradigm and the literature on disaster vulnerability and cultural tailoring, we conducted a between-subjects experiment with 441 Black, Hispanic, and Caucasian residents of Florida. Our results suggest that GenAI chatbots varying in tone formality and cultural tailoring significantly influence perceptions of their friendliness and credibility, which, in turn, relate to hurricane preparedness outcomes. These results highlight the potential of using GenAI chatbots to improve diverse communities’ disaster preparedness.

stories.hook: ¿Los descansos en redes sociales ayudan o perjudican al estudio?
stories.headline: Los descansos en redes sociales pueden ser recuperación o procrastinación
stories.finding: Los estudiantes reportan que los descansos en redes sociales pueden actuar como comportamiento de recuperación, favoreciendo su bienestar y desempeño académico. Sin embargo, bajo ciertas motivaciones y contextos ambientales, el mismo descanso se transforma en procrastinación, perjudicando el rendimiento.
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo orienta a diseñar intervenciones que estructuren los descansos digitales, potenciando factores motivacionales y ambientales que favorezcan la recuperación y evitando los que inducen procrastinación, mejorando así la gestión del tiempo y el aprendizaje.
stories.paperTitle: Social Media Breaks: An Opportunity for Recovery and Procrastination
stories.journal: Proceedings of the ACM on Human-Computer Interaction
stories.originalAbstract: Social media (SM) breaks from studying can either support students' wellbeing and performance by acting as a recovery behaviour or subvert it by acting as a procrastination behaviour. It is currently unclear which influences lead an SM break to be a positive recovery vs. negative procrastination behaviour. A behavioural and emotion regulation (ER) perspective may help to elucidate these influences. In this paper, we report a semi-structured interview study with 20 undergraduates to explore their experiences of SM breaks when studying. Our analysis describes how motivational and environmental factors can influence a break's propensity for recovery or procrastination during the break initiation and execution phases. We apply an ER perspective to these reports and demonstrate how it helps to explain further in which circumstances SM breaks are likely to support recovery or procrastination. Based on this analysis, we present recommendations for designing interventions to support healthy breaks and reduce unhealthy ones.

stories.hook: ¿Cuántas mujeres desarrollan PTSD tras un aborto espontáneo?
stories.headline: Alto riesgo de trastorno de estrés postraumático tras el aborto espontáneo
stories.finding: Una revisión sistemática encontró que, a una semana y media del aborto, el 32,5 % de las mujeres presentan ansiedad, el 30,1 % depresión y el 33,6 % estrés significativo. Además, el 29 % desarrolló PTSD a un mes, disminuyendo al 18 % a los nueve meses.
stories.takeaway: Estos datos indican que el aborto espontáneo es un factor de alto riesgo para trastornos psicológicos graves, lo que obliga a los profesionales de salud a implementar cribados tempranos y ofrecer intervenciones psicológicas específicas para prevenir PTSD y depresión.
stories.paperTitle: Miscarriage as a psychological trauma: a comprehensive review of psychiatric sequelae and clinical implications
stories.originalAbstract: Abstract Background Miscarriage, affecting 15–25% of clinically recognized pregnancies, carries substantial but underrecognized psychiatric consequences for both women and their partners. While medical care often prioritizes physical management, growing evidence highlights persistent psychological morbidity following pregnancy loss. Main body This review synthesizes high-quality literature from 2014 to 2024 on the prevalence, clinical presentation, temporal course, and risk factors of psychiatric sequelae after miscarriage, as well as current practices in screening and intervention. Within six weeks post-loss, pooled estimates indicate that 32.5% of women experience anxiety, 30.1% develop depression, and 33.6% report significant stress, with post-traumatic stress disorder affecting 29% at one month and 18% at nine months. Complicated grief occurs in 25–30% of parents, and 15–20% develop chronic or delayed psychopathology. Male partners also experience considerable distress, with anxiety affecting up to 66.3% and depression 19% following recurrent loss. Risk factors include previous losses, pre-existing mental health conditions, lack of social support, poor partner relationships, childlessness, lower socioeconomic status, and dissatisfaction with healthcare. Protective factors comprise strong social support, high-quality marital relationships, the presence of living children, and satisfaction with medical care. Despite validated screening tools and evidence-based psychosocial interventions, routine mental health assessment after miscarriage is rare. Conclusions Miscarriage thus represents a major public health concern with lasting psychiatric impact. Bridging the gap between psychological need and clinical practice requires universal screening, referral pathways to evidence-based support, integration of biopsychosocial care models, clinician education, and societal acknowledgment of miscarriage as a legitimate source of grief.

stories.hook: ¿Qué tipo de ejercicio potencia la función ejecutiva en TDAH?
stories.headline: El ejercicio basado en habilidades supera al aeróbico en control inhibitorio y flexibilidad cognitiva TDAH
stories.finding: En un meta‑análisis de red con 21 ensayos controlados aleatorizados (N=1 491) en niños y adolescentes con TDAH, el ejercicio basado en habilidades mejoró más el control inhibitorio (SMD = 0,73) y la flexibilidad cognitiva (SMD = 3,08) que el aeróbico aislado. El ejercicio combinado también superó a los controles en memoria de trabajo (SMD = 0,73).
stories.takeaway: Este hallazgo orienta a clínicos y educadores a priorizar programas de ejercicio que integren habilidades motoras, pues pueden potenciar funciones ejecutivas críticas en niños con TDAH, ofreciendo una intervención no farmacológica de alta efectividad.
stories.paperTitle: Exercise prescription to improve executive functioning in children and adolescents with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder: a network meta-analysis
stories.originalAbstract: Objective: This study employs a network meta-analysis to investigate the potential effects of exercise type, duration, frequency, intensity, and cycle on executive functions (inhibitory control, working memory, cognitive flexibility) in children and adolescents with ADHD, thereby providing directional insights for future research. Methods: Five databases were systematically searched up to February 1, 2025, yielding 21 RCTs (n = 1,491) involving participants aged 7-18 years. The risk of bias was assessed using Cochrane tools. Standardised mean differences (SMDs) were used as effect measures, while SUCRA was used for probability ranking and GRADE for evidence quality grading. Results: Skill-based exercise outperformed isolated aerobic exercise in inhibitory control (SMD = 0.73, 95% CI 0.31-1.41) and cognitive flexibility (SMD = 3.08, 95% CI 0.52-5.63). Combined exercise outperformed controls in working memory (SMD = 0.73, 95% CI 0.35-1.12). SUCRA ranking indicated the highest cumulative probability for skill-based exercise in inhibitory control (95.8) and cognitive flexibility (95.5), while aerobic exercise had the highest probability for working memory (87.1). Sensitivity analyses indicated that estimates for cognitive flexibility were significantly influenced by individual studies, demonstrating limited robustness. Conclusion: Preliminary evidence suggests that moderate-intensity, skill-based exercise may improve inhibitory control and cognitive flexibility within 6-10 weeks. Aerobic exercise may enhance working memory within 4-5 weeks. However, factors such as ADHD subtypes, age, and dose-response relationships remain unclear. Clinical implementation should be individualised and await high-quality validation.

stories.hook: ¿Cómo influye la piedad filial en la carga del cuidador?
stories.headline: La piedad filial se revela como factor clave en la carga y bienestar del cuidador
stories.finding: El análisis de 26 estudios identificó cuatro antecedentes de la piedad filial: obligación como 'gen cultural', altruismo, solidaridad familiar y expectativa social de 'derecho de nacimiento'. Sus atributos (apoyo y emocional, obediencia, reverencia) se asocian a carga del cuidador, bienestar psicológico y físico, calidad de vida y equidad en salud.
stories.takeaway: Comprender la piedad filial permite diseñar intervenciones culturalmente sensibles que reduzcan la carga del cuidador y mejoren su bienestar, favoreciendo la equidad en salud de familias chinas y chino‑americanas.
stories.paperTitle: Filial piety and older adult caregiving among Chinese and Chinese-American families in the United States: a concept analysis
stories.originalAbstract: BACKGROUND: The culturally sensitive nursing practice has not embedded filial piety as a cultural value and stance pertaining to caregiving among aging Chinese and Chinese-American (CCA) families in the United States, yet it is critical for healthy aging among CCAs. PURPOSE: To understand filial piety when caring for aging CCAs and conceptualize an operational definition and framework. METHODS: A systematic search was conducted in CINAHL, PubMed, Scopus, and PsycINFO databases. Analysis of the concept of filial piety among CCAs used Walker and Avant's methods. Twenty-six studies were selected in the final full-text analysis. FINDINGS: Synthesis of evidence identified four antecedents: (a) filial obligation as a 'cultural gene', (b) sense of altruism, (c) familial solidarity, and (d) societal expectation of 'birth right'. Attributes included familial material and emotional support, obedience, pious reverence, and societal norms. Consequences were related to caregiver burden, psychological and physical well-being, quality of life, and health equity. CONCLUSION: Filial piety is an intrinsic desire to support aging parents and an extrinsic desire to adhere to Chinese societal moral tenets. The proposed operational framework "Caregiving for aging CCAs in the United States" merits further study.

stories.hook: ¿Puede la inflamación explicar la depresión en la menopausia?
stories.headline: Deficiencia de estrógeno desencadena inflamación y altera la neuroplasticidad en la depresión menopáusica
stories.finding: Los autores mostraron que la caída de estrógenos en la menopausia desestabiliza la homeostasis inmune, elevando citocinas inflamatorias mediante vías ERα/ERβ/GPER que activan NLRP3/NF‑κB. Esta inflamación daña la barrera hematoencefálica, reduce BDNF y debilita la neuroplasticidad, y los fármacos que inhiben citocinas o NLRP3/NF‑κB son prometedores.
stories.takeaway: Comprender que la deficiencia de estrógeno provoca inflamación que compromete la neuroplasticidad permite diseñar tratamientos que restauren la homeostasis inmune, ofreciendo una vía prometedora para aliviar la depresión en la menopausia.
stories.originalAbstract: A significant decrease in estrogen levels puts menopausal women at high risk for major depression, which remains difficult to cure despite its relatively clear etiology. With the discovery of abnormally elevated inflammation in menopausal depressed women, immune imbalance has become a novel focus in the study of menopausal depression. In this paper, we examined the characteristics and possible mechanisms of immune imbalance caused by decreased estrogen levels during menopause and found that estrogen deficiency disrupted immune homeostasis, especially the levels of inflammatory cytokines through the ERα/ERβ/GPER-associated NLRP3/NF-κB signaling pathways. We also analyzed the destruction of the blood-brain barrier, dysfunction of neurotransmitters, blockade of BDNF synthesis, and attenuation of neuroplasticity caused by inflammatory cytokine activity, and investigated estrogen-immuno-neuromodulation disorders in menopausal depression. Current research suggests that drugs targeting inflammatory cytokines and NLRP3/NF-κB signaling molecules are promising for restoring homeostasis of the estrogen-immuno-neuromodulation system and may play a positive role in the intervention and treatment of menopausal depression.
